inlines.v: SUBDIVISION, noun 1. The act of subdividing or separating a part into smaller parts. 2. The part of a thing made by subdividing; the part of a larger part. In the decimal table, the subdivision s of the cubit, as span, palm, and digit, are deduced from the shorter cubit.
